description: Get an envelope's evidence record as JSON: the envelope, all signers, the hash-chained audit trail (with start/end timestamps), and — when the envelope has been anchored — its blockchain verification. This is a record to read, not the sealed bundle: it carries no PDF and no signed manifest, so a third party cannot verify it on its own. For the verifiable artifact, use get_evidence_bundle. Use verify_blockchain when you only need the on-chain anchor. Requires the envelopes:read scope on your API key.

envelopeId.description: Envelope ID to get the evidence record for

name: get_evidence
